verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any way to schedule recurring jobs or workflows in Paychex Flex. 'Recurring Deduction' is a payroll deduction setting, not a recurring job scheduler, and the 'one click' payroll run is a one-off action rather than a recurring schedule. Automatic tax filing is a built-in service behavior, not user-configurable workflow scheduling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
